## Add a plugin to the list

Fill in every field. Keep `plugins.json` alphabetical by name.

```json
{
  "name": "",
  "author": "",
  "repo": "owner/repo",
  "version": "",
  "updated": "YYYY-MM-DD"
}
```

Checklist:

- [ ] A GitHub release exists on my plugin repo with the plugin jar attached.
- [ ] `name` is unique in `plugins.json`.
- [ ] `repo` is `owner/repo` format and points at the plugin's repo.
- [ ] `updated` matches the latest release date.
